description: Predict restriction-digest fragment sizes and their gel migration positions against a chosen DNA ladder.

enzymes.description: Enzyme names to digest with, from the curated common-enzyme set (see restriction_sites for the full list). An unrecognized name is rejected rather than skipped, so an empty band pattern always means "no sites".

ladder.description: DNA ladder to plot alongside the sample lane.

sequence.description: Nucleotide sequence (raw or FASTA; IUPAC accepted).

name: virtual_gel
title: Virtual gel
